data.title: Chat: message permalinks — expose message ids in the UI, anchor-link references

data.body: Origin: board DM msg 222 (human:forrest, 2026-08-30 21:15) — created on behalf of the board. Requirement: (1) every rendered message in the chat UI displays its message number alongside the message; (2) when a message body references another message by number/name (e.g. 'msg 156', '[218]'), the reference renders as an anchor link that navigates to and highlights the target message; (3) deep links survive refresh — build on the AS-9 query-string URL state so a message anchor is addressable in the URL. Cross-conversation references should at minimum work within the current conversation; linking across conversations is a planning-stage decision. Left in backlog — planning runs in a later tick.

Board directive (DM msg 230, human:forrest): implementation kickoff is now implicit for internal-tools work — no per-task board green-light needed. Marcus implements. Normal lifecycle still applies (plan -> implement -> QA review); what's removed is the per-task board wait, not the gates. AS-26 goes first; AS-27 lands on top of it.
